pins.name: D23
pins.label: GPIO23 (Led active low)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard plain red status LED, ACTIVE-LOW. Confirmed via Zephyr's official adafruit_metro_rp2350_rp2350b_m33.dts leds node (gpios = <&gpio0 23 GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW>) and Adafruit's own learn.adafruit.com pinouts/CircuitPython pins.c (board.LED / PIN_LED). digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high/led_low precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins; pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2350 GPIO. NOTE: polarity is the OPPOSITE of the RP2040 Metro sibling's GPIO13 LED (active-high there, active-low here) — independently reconfirmed, not a copy-paste assumption. No SPI/Wire/Serial alias exists on this GPIO.

pins.name: D24
pins.label: GPIO24 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON — onboard 'Boot0' button, also readable as a normal application GPIO (unlike the classic RP2040 Pico/Pico 2's non-GPIO BOOTSEL trick). Confirmed via this board's own pins_arduino.h macro name/comment AND independently via CircuitPython's pins.c, where BOTH "BUTTON" and "BOOT" board-name aliases map to pin_GPIO24 — strong two-source corroboration. Not present at all on the RP2040 Metro sibling (no PIN_BUTTON macro there; its RESET/BOOT are non-GPIO). No SPI/Wire/Serial alias exists on this GPIO.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: GPIO25 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line, unchanged from the RP2040 Metro sibling. Confirmed via Adafruit's own learn.adafruit.com pinouts/neopixel guides, Zephyr's adafruit_metro_rp2350_rp2350b_m33.dts ws2812 node (gpios = <&gpio0 25 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>, chain-length = <1>), and CircuitPython pins.c ("NEOPIXEL" -> pin_GPIO25). No SPI/Wire/Serial alias exists on this GPIO.
